name: BROAD_CONDITIONAL_REDISTRIBUTION
representation_neutral_definition: Frozen C->D conditional distribution/contrast over exact risk set and baseline
minimum_evidence_or_interface: OF003-like direct conditional interface or any weaker lawful equivalent
citc_or_support_dependency: SUPPORT_CONTRACT; CITC only for material/nonzero language
notes: No representation name enters claim identity

name: EXACT_JOINT_CONDITIONING_DOMAIN
representation_neutral_definition: Finite exact conjunction predicates over preregistered same-unit Z tuple, complete under frozen generator/domain rule
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Exact joint predicate identity and outcome-blind domain generation
citc_or_support_dependency: SUPPORT_CONTRACT for later admission; no materiality threshold
notes: Ephemeral enumeration does not erase exact joint-state relation

name: JOINT_STATE_SUPPORT_AND_ARM_SUPPORT
representation_neutral_definition: Exact support for each joint predicate overall and on required contrast arms
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Direct fact/support query plus replayable exact membership
notes: Respondent IDs are evidence prerequisite, not default published claim slot

name: WITHIN_STATE_CONDITIONAL_REDISTRIBUTION
representation_neutral_definition: Same frozen C->D estimand recomputed inside each support-admitted exact joint predicate
minimum_evidence_or_interface: OF003-like conditional query parameterized by exact predicate
notes: No silent pooling/backoff unless later claim explicitly defines it

name: BROAD_WITHIN_RELATION
representation_neutral_definition: Frozen sign/order/material-difference relation REL(Q0,Qs)
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Deterministic claim-native comparison over AS01 and AS04
notes: Order/sign among claim outputs is not respondent/state neighborhood

name: COMPOUND_HETEROGENEITY_STATUS
representation_neutral_definition: Deterministic state-set classification: persistence/reversal/split/disappearance/material-other/unresolved
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Predeclared logical aggregation over AS05 plus AS03 admission states
notes: ANY/ALL/count logic is composition, not fusion

name: EXPLICIT_ABSTENTION_COVERAGE
representation_neutral_definition: Every candidate state and compound path ends in typed answer or typed abstention
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Complete state roster, support statuses, query result statuses
notes: Prevents support-driven result laundering

name: MINORITY_STATUS
representation_neutral_definition: Whether an admitted joint state is minority/modal/rare under declared descriptive rule
citc_or_support_dependency: If later material threshold enters claim, new CIM/CITC required
notes: Minority reversal is stronger claim than reversal

name: RESPONDENT_MEMBERSHIP_OUTPUT
representation_neutral_definition: Published list of empirical-unit IDs per state
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Exact replay evidence exists beneath support
citc_or_support_dependency: NONE unless membership itself is claim
notes: Membership recoverability remains hard producer evidence

name: CARRIER_REUSE_COMPRESSION
representation_neutral_definition: Storage/replay/runtime characteristics of lossless carrier
notes: Engineering utility only

name: NULL_FIXTURE_SEPARATION
representation_neutral_definition: Observed-vs-null separation under registered empirical null
notes: Important architecture evidence but not automatically claim truth

name: DIRECT_CONDITIONAL_QUERY_SET
representation_neutral_definition: Finite direct query set/generator returns support, broad, within-state and comparison outputs without retaining broader state surface
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Exact predicates plus direct query engine
citc_or_support_dependency: Must preserve all AS01-AS07 within later contracts
notes: Cannot call empirical joint-state enumeration relation-free

name: OF001_PLUS_OF003_COMPOSED_SET
representation_neutral_definition: Direct facts supply exact state support; direct conditional objects supply broad and within-state distributions; exact-key join plus claim comparison
notes: Strongest obvious low-commitment set

name: LOSSLESS_CARRIER_PLUS_TYPED_QUERY_OPERATORS
representation_neutral_definition: One bounded lossless same-unit carrier feeds W1/W2-style lawful queries
minimum_evidence_or_interface: Carrier exact recoverability + atomic query authority
citc_or_support_dependency: No new semantic authority from derivability
notes: Carrier may add replay/reuse without adding claim truth

name: EXACT_CONFIGURATION_OBJECT
representation_neutral_definition: Exact coexposed joint-state relation over frozen Z members; may answer support and conditionals by lawful marginalization
notes: Persistence/storage is not constitutive to AOS identity

name: OF002_PLUS_OF003
representation_neutral_definition: Exact joint-state object plus separate direct conditional interface
notes: Candidate if OF002 alone lacks full conditional interface

name: ORDER_OR_NEIGHBORHOOD_RELATION
representation_neutral_definition: No claim slot asks for neighbor/local-order relation among respondents or empirical states
notes: AS05 output sign/order does not create OF004 need

name: CARDINAL_GEOMETRY
representation_neutral_definition: No metric magnitude/coordinate/interpolation invariant is constitutive
notes: Exclude rather than run as prestige competitor

name: INCIDENCE_OR_TOPOLOGY
representation_neutral_definition: No connectivity/reachability/incidence invariant is constitutive
notes: Source topology remains provenance/control only

name: LATENT_MIXTURE_OR_MODEL
representation_neutral_definition: No model/prediction/compression invariant is constitutive
notes: No phase-2 admission by default

name: MOTIF_OR_SIGNATURE
representation_neutral_definition: No recurrence/motif invariant is constitutive
notes: Counterpattern is not motif recurrence

name: TRANSPORT_SIGNATURE
representation_neutral_definition: Question class is local; no cross-context preservation predicate
notes: Transport requires separate CIM

name: COMPOSITE_FUSION_OBJECT
representation_neutral_definition: Separate AOS only if composition creates new primitive relation/learned bridge/semantic equivalence or interaction estimand
notes: Default base-class status is composition without fusion
